name: Instant Infinite Loader
author: Nababur

sections.description:
Instant Infinite Loader brings a fluid, smooth user experience to your WordPress site by allowing infinite scroll functionality or a ‘Load More’ button for posts, products, and custom post types. This powerful plugin also supports AJAX pagination and isotope filter loading, providing an enhanced browsing experience for your visitors.

Features Overview:

✅ Instant Infinite Scroll for posts, products, or custom post types.
✅ Load More Button for manually loading additional content.
✅ AJAX Pagination for seamless browsing between pages.
✅ Isotope Filter Loader for filtered content loading.

( TRY LIVE DEMO ) Instant Scroll | Instant Loadmore | Instant Pagination | Instant Filter

Features

Posts Settings:

✅ Choose Date Format: Select your preferred date format for post listing.
✅ Hide Author Name?: Option to hide the author’s name.
✅ Hide Category?: Option to hide the category name.
✅ Grid Style: Display posts in a grid layout.
✅ Select Animate Style: Choose animation style for post content.
✅ Hide Animation Time: Control the visibility duration of animations.
✅ Set Animation Time: Define the duration of animations.
✅ Choose Button Style: Customize the button style for ‘Load More’ functionality.
✅ Title Excerpt: Display a shortened version of the post title.
✅ Post Excerpt Content: Display a brief excerpt from the post content.

WooCommerce Settings:

✅ Hide Add To Cart Button?: Option to hide the ‘Add to Cart’ button.
✅ Hide Quick View Button?: Option to hide the quick view button.
✅ Hide Product Category?: Option to hide product categories.
✅ Hide Product Label?: Option to hide the product label.
✅ Select Animate Style: Choose animation style for WooCommerce products.
✅ Hide Animate Effect: Option to disable animations.
✅ Set Animation Time: Control the animation duration for WooCommerce products.
✅ Title Excerpt Time: Set the time duration for the product title excerpt.
✅ Title Excerpt: Display a shortened version of the product title.
✅ Hide Short Description?: Option to hide the product’s short description.
✅ Post Excerpt Content: Display a brief excerpt from the product content.
✅ Hide Product Price?: Option to hide the product price.

Infinite Scroll Settings:

✅ Choose Product Type: Choose between post, product, or custom post types for infinite scroll.
✅ Order By: Define the order of content based on parameters like date or popularity.
✅ Order: Select ascending or descending order for content.
✅ Posts Per Page: Define how many posts or products to load per scroll.
✅ Ignore Sticky Post?: Option to exclude sticky posts.
✅ Select Preloader Style: Choose from 20 different preloader styles for infinite scroll.

Load More Settings:

✅ Choose Post Type: Select the post type (post, product, or custom post) for the ‘Load More’ button.
✅ Order By: Define the order of content based on parameters.
✅ Order: Select ascending or descending order for content.
✅ Posts Per Page: Set the number of posts/products per ‘Load More’.
✅ Ignore Sticky Post?: Option to exclude sticky posts.
✅ Change Load More Button Text: Customize the text for the ‘Load More’ button.

Pagination More Settings:

✅ Choose Post Type: Choose post type for pagination settings.
✅ Order By: Define the order of content.
✅ Order: Select ascending or descending order.
✅ Posts Per Page: Control the number of posts or products per pagination.
✅ Ignore Sticky Post?: Exclude sticky posts.
✅ Change Next Text: Customize the “Next” pagination text.
✅ Change Previous Text: Customize the “Previous” pagination text.

Filter More Settings:

✅ Choose Post Type: Select post type for the filter feature.
✅ Order By: Define the order of filtered content.
✅ Order: Select ascending or descending order for filtered content.
✅ Ignore Sticky Post?: Option to exclude sticky posts.

💡 Available Shortcodes:
👉 [iiloader_infinite_scroll] – Enables automatic infinite scrolling.
👉 [iiloader_infinite_loadmore] – Adds a user-friendly “Load More” button.
👉 [iiloader_infinite_pagination] – Implements dynamic pagination.
👉 [iiloader_infinite_filter] – Allows filtering content without refreshing the page.

sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin zip file.
  2. Go to the WordPress admin dashboard.
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New and click Upload Plugin.
  4. Choose the plugin file and click Install Now.
  5. Activate the plugin from the Plugins menu.
  6. Configure settings from the Instant Infinite Loader menu.
